name: design-stock
description: Indexed storefront design templates for the store-platform showroom.

scripts.build: npm --prefix designs/basic run build --workspaces=false && npm --prefix designs/beauty run build --workspaces=false && npm --prefix designs/fashion run build --workspaces=false && npm --prefix designs/electronics run build --workspaces=false && npm --prefix designs/nexa run build --workspaces=false
scripts.build:apps: npm --prefix apps/dashboard run build --workspaces=false && npm --prefix apps/showroom run build --workspaces=false && npm --prefix apps/platform-admin run build --workspaces=false
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix designs/basic run typecheck --workspaces=false && npm --prefix designs/beauty run typecheck --workspaces=false && npm --prefix designs/fashion run typecheck --workspaces=false && npm --prefix designs/electronics run typecheck --workspaces=false && npm --prefix designs/nexa run typecheck --workspaces=false
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm --prefix apps/dashboard run typecheck --workspaces=false && npm --prefix apps/showroom run typecheck --workspaces=false && npm --prefix apps/platform-admin run typecheck --workspaces=false
scripts.quality: npm run validate:manifest && npm run validate:design-quality && npm run validate:seo && npm run security:audit && npm run test:dashboard && npm run test:dashboard:e2e && npm run test:showroom && npm run test:platform-admin && npm run test:platform-admin:e2e && npm run test:storefront-core && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:apps
scripts.release:verify: npm run quality && npm run build && npm run build:apps && npm run smoke:premium
